sdc.daemon.ExcludeEntry.title: ExcludeEntry
sdc.daemon.ExcludeEntry.description: An entry of the exclude list of a context copy: a name matched at any depth (target/, fixtures) or a relative path from the context root (docs/big/); one that ends in / matches a directory only, one without it a directory or a file, and a name matches a whole name only. An absolute path, an empty, . or .. part, a NUL, more than 200 characters or more than 64 entries are refused before anything is written (400), naming the member and the entry's place, never its value.
